newsitem.title: USA: Cyclone Karlette heading towards Mauritius -WSC.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone Karlette heading towards Mauritius -WSC.

text.p: Tropical cyclone Karlette is heading towards Mauritius and is expected to approach the island in about 48 hours, private forecaster Weather Services Corp said.
Top winds are now 50 mph but they may increase to 70 mph during the next 48 hours. The island can expect to see increasing wind and seas later this period.
Karlette continues as mostly a risk to shipping in the southwest Indian Ocean during the next 36 hours.
